ground_truth.main_content:
Stress-Free Moving with North American Van Lines

About 3 million people rely on long distance moving companies in the U.S. every year. If you're preparing for a cross-country relocation, whether for a new job, a marriage, or a fresh start, North American Van Lines delivers the reliable long distance moving services you need for a smooth, stress-free transition.

Tips for a Successful Long Distance Move

Start Early: Begin planning at least 6 weeks before your move
Declutter: Reduce costs by donating or selling items you no longer need
Label Boxes: Clearly mark boxes with their contents and destination rooms

Long Distance Moving Costs: What to Expect

Several factors influence what a long distance moving company will charge for your move:

Distance between locations
Volume and weight of items being moved
Additional services like packing or storage

North American Van Lines vs. The Alternatives

We go beyond containers, truck rentals, and moving brokers to provide full-service moves with professional movers, personalized care, and transparent pricing.

Frequently Asked Questions

How far in advance should I book my move?

We recommend booking at least 2-3 months ahead to ensure availability.

What is the average cost of a long-distance move?

The average cost of a long distance move is $4,500. This is based on an average weight of 7,000 lbs. (7 rooms) and a traveling distance of 1,000 miles. The price of your move will largely depend on the number of belongings you need to be moved, and the distance you are going. To get a more accurate cost, fill out our Quote on Demand above.

What is the cheapest way to do a long distance move?

Doing it yourself is often the cheapest option when moving long distances. You won't pay any fees to professional movers, and you'll save money on fuel costs. However, if you plan to do all your own packing, loading, unloading, unpacking, and cleaning services, you may end up spending more time and effort than hiring professionals while forgoing the insurance coverage a mover brings with them. This is why we always recommend hiring professionals for a long distance move.

How long will it take for my items to arrive?

The answer largely depends on which type of mover you use and how far you are moving. If you choose to work with a professional long-distance moving company like North American Van Lines, your items should typically arrive within 10-14 days. Keep in mind that this is just an average; it could take more or less time depending on the distance and other factors such as weather or traffic delays.

Do you offer coverage for my belongings?

Yes, we provide comprehensive moving valuation coverage options for added peace of mind.

Do you charge extra for stairs or long carries from the truck to my door?

No, we won't charge you extra. Our pricing includes all necessary tools and equipment needed for your relocation. After you request a free online estimate, a relocation specialist on our team will contact you to learn more about the specifics of your move and develop a personalized moving package for your specific needs.

What's included in my quote, and what services cost extra?

A typical long-distance moving package includes loading, transporting and unloading. If you need help with all aspects of your move, including packing and unpacking, consider a full-service moving package. With this option, our long-distance movers will do all of the heavy lifting for you. Storage solutions, auto shipping and fragile-only packing services are add-ons available for an additional fee.

Do you move on weekends and holidays?

Yes, we can schedule your move on the weekend or on certain holidays. We recommend scheduling out-of-state movers at least two to three months in advance to lock in your desired dates.

Do you disassemble and reassemble furniture?

Yes, our full-service long-distance movers can assist with disassembling and reassembling furniture for you. These long-distance moving services are included in our full-service packages.

How long does a long-distance move typically take?

Long-distance moves can take anywhere from one to two weeks to complete. The exact duration will depend on your home size and distance. Traffic and unexpected weather can also cause additional delays.
